displayName: Citrus API: /api/health draftToken not ok (edge uptime check)

documentation.content:
**What it means.** The public uptime check on `https://citrusfantasysports.com/api/health` is failing from 2+ regions. It fails when the API is unreachable, answers non-2xx, or answers 200 without `checks.draftToken == "ok"`. That last case is the 2026-09-16 outage: the serving Cloud Run revision had no `SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET`, discovery threw on every call, and every draft room in production sat on "Reconnecting..." while every other signal was green.

**What to do (in order).**
1. `curl -s https://citrusfantasysports.com/api/health | jq .` - read `status` and `checks`.
2. `checks.draftToken == unconfigured` -> the serving revision has no secret. `gcloud run services update citrus-api --region=northamerica-northeast1 --project=citrus-fantasy-prod --update-secrets=SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET=supabase-jwt-secret:latest`
3. `checks.draftToken == broken` -> the secret is present but sign/verify fails; compare the Secret Manager version the API mounts to the one the engine VM read at boot (`deployment.fingerprint` log line).
4. Non-2xx or unreachable -> Cloud Run revision health: `gcloud run services describe citrus-api --region=northamerica-northeast1 --format='value(status.conditions)'`, then Firebase Hosting rewrite in `firebase.json`.

Managed by `infra/gcp/monitoring/apply-uptime.sh` (`alert-uptime-api-draft-token.json`). Edit the file, re-run the script; do not hand-edit in the console.
